$comment: How the token files combine (DTCG resolver): base set (tokens.space-shape.json is generated by tools/space-shape.mjs from space-shape.config.json; tokens.colour.json by tools/colour.mjs from colour.config.json), one theme context, then modifiers. Each modifier context also reads tokens.<modifier>-echo.json, generated by tools/token-contexts.mjs, so aliases of the tokens it overrides follow a subtree's context. Built by agentic-craft/tools/build-tokens.mjs (npm run tokens).

contrast.$comment: 'standard' is listed before 'more' so the system's more-contrast media rule still wins at :root; a person's explicit choice is set on an element below :root (the library app sets it on body).

space.$comment: The theme's space (space-shape.config.json) everywhere by default; any subtree can switch with data-space, including back to the theme's own option. Contexts generated by tools/space-shape.mjs.

shape.$comment: The theme's shape (space-shape.config.json) everywhere by default; any subtree can switch with data-shape, including back to the theme's own option. Contexts generated by tools/space-shape.mjs.
